page.content:
Mexico City stadium of 1970 and Maradona's 1986 quarter-final.

How Estadio Azteca connects

  • Event: Hand of God — The Hand of God was scored at Estadio Azteca.
  • Event: 1970 FIFA World Cup — The 1970 World Cup final was played at Estadio Azteca.

What is Estadio Azteca?

Estadio Azteca hosted the 1970 and 1986 World Cup finals and the 1986 quarter-final in which Maradona scored both the Hand of God and the Goal of the Century.

Key threads lead to Hand of God and 1970 FIFA World Cup.
